overview: Smoggie Queens is an out and out comedy centred around a gang of friends who are fiercely proud of their North Eastern town of Middlesbrough and their small pocket of the LGBTQ+ community. Smoggie Queens tells the story of volatile Dickie along with drag queen Mam, self-styled hun Lucinda, awkward Sal and newcomer Stewart as they navigate love, life and their pride for a town that feels neglected in its own little corner of the UK. It's an underdog story on two fronts, so expect a few passionate scraps that may send your wig flying!
title: Smoggie Queens

overview: Former British Army captain Ed Stafford invites dads and their children into his wilderness adventure school, helping struggling modern families by stripping them of all the distractions of the 21st century and putting them through some of the toughest outdoor experiences.
title: Into the Jungle with Ed Stafford

overview: Bella Calamidades (Beautiful But Unlucky) is a Spanish-language romantic thriller telenovela produced by RTI Producciones for Caracol TV and Telemundo. It includes 140 series. The filming started in late 2009 and ended in 2010, but it was until September 16, 2013 when the serial debuted on Telemundo. The story involves a beautiful, passionate woman named Lola, who is an outcast in a town dominated by superstition. Convinced that she brings misfortune to everyone, Lola shies away from other people. When her hiding place is discovered, she returns to her home town, when a series of freakish events inevitably lead to tragedy. Heartbroken and fearing for her life at the hands of the villagers, Lola loves hope one man's love and another's generosity change her life. No one trusts her except for the man who truly loves her.
title: Bella Calamidades

overview: Voted Most Likely to Succeed in high school, Maggie Winters thought she could do anything- until her marriage failed and career went nowhere. To regain her confidence, she decides to return to her hometown to get support from old friends.
title: Maggie Winters

overview: In the Hospital's department for undetermined stomach and heart diseases, there are three patients who seem to be enjoying themselves rudely, miscellaneous worker Bert Hersby, Östermalm resident Rutger Ahlenius and mother pig Patrik Larsson. They are cared for with a firm hand by the slightly distracted Dr. Söderberg and nurse Nader, who insists on calling all patients "Svenne".
title: Sjukan

overview: A mind-blowing romp through history builds a pathway to the present – and a breakthrough that stands to profoundly change our future.
title: Connections with James Burke

overview: West End Murders is the story of three murdered women: their lives, their deaths and two failed police investigations. Following former Met Police DCI Colin Sutton and his team, this investigation examines the historic cold case of the ‘Bunny Girl' murders, uncovering a key link between the murders of Eve Stratford, Lynda Farrow and the seemingly unconnected case of murdered schoolgirl Lynne Weedon, revealing the pattern of a potential serial killer gone unnoticed for decades in the process. With this new revelation, can Sutton and his team finally bring justice and close the book on a 40-year-old case once and for all?
title: West End Murders

overview: The promise of love begins with a simple, aspirational girl, Amor de Jesus (Jodi Sta. Maria), who fell in love with a rich man, Eduardo Buenavista (Ian Veneracion). Their whirlwind romance bore a child but was put to an end after all the challenges and objection of Eduardo's affluent family. Amor loses all hope when Eduardo marries Claudia Salameda (Angelica Panganiban) and her daughter, Maria Amor, dies. Years passed and Amor's daughter turns out to be alive and will grow up as Yna Macaspac (Kathryn Bernardo). Yna meets Eduardo and Claudia's son, Angelo Buenavista (Daniel Padilla), and falls in love. Amor returns to the Philippines as Amor Powers. She tries to avenge the death of her daughter by destroying Eduardo's life and family, which unwittingly will hurt her own daughter, Yna, in the process. An all-out war begins between Amor Powers and Claudia Buenavista.
title: Pangako Sa'yo

overview: The adopted daughter of Holocaust survivor Ephraim Zamir falls victim to a brutal attack by neo-Nazis. Zamir then makes a drastic decision: he takes the two perpetrators under his control and broadcasts the following events online. From now on he lets the community vote on the life and death of the men.
title: Turmschatten

overview: The Two Ronnies Spectacle aims to give comedy-lovers a charming insight into one of Britain's most interesting and well-loved double acts - The Two Ronnies. It will include rarely seen footage of the duo. The series will delve deep into some of the exciting spectacles from The Two Ronnies, featuring an exclusive interview with Ronnie Corbett himself. Ronnie will also visit the Victoria & Albert Museum to unearth stored personal memorabilia of Ronnie Barker - artefacts that have not been seen on TV before. Each show will contain numerous classic sketches from their BBC primetime series, alongside rare material from the UK and abroad. As well as in-depth and revealing interviews with friends and colleagues.
title: The Two Ronnies Spectacle

overview: Su Ke, a member of the archaeology club, accidentally time-travels to the era of Wu Guo when she touches the General Order. She gets caught up in a murder investigation led by General Dai Yu and is forced to marry him because her face resembles that of the victim. In her quest for the truth alongside Dai Yu, Su Ke discovers several of her clubmates who are also trapped in that era, including Sun Duo, who is now an emperor. With Sun Duo's help, they manage to capture the real murderer, but a bigger secret is still waiting to be uncovered.
title: General Order

overview: Chen Zhuo, heir to the Chen family, becomes a security guard at Xu Meiying's company to uncover the truth about his mother's death but unexpectedly ends up as her live-in son-in-law. Meanwhile, his twin brother, Chen Yue, impersonates him to stay close to Meiying and claim the inheritance. Battling family pressure, Chen Zhuo exposes Chen Yue's deceit, restores order, and chooses to share his life with Xu Meiying.
title: The Best Man

overview: Explore NZ's recent history - the wonderful, the hidden and the controversial. Join Scotty and Stacey Morrison, as they showcase unique historical objects and their personal stories. Made with the support of NZ On Air and Te Māngai Pāho.
title: National Treasures

overview: To get viewers ready for a new season of "Belle Collective," OWN is introducing "Flash Belle Fridays," a special companion series. Executive producer and creator Carlos King will sit down for some Southern kiki with OG Belle Dr. Antoinette Liles and the newest member of the Collective, Selena. Every Friday leading up to the new season premiere, the trio flashes back to seminal past episodes of the series to reminisce, share behind-the-scenes stories, and reveal a few surprises. The drinks will also be flowing as Selena, a skilled bartender, crafts a new specialty drink each week.
title: Flash Belle Fridays

overview: Air and Marine Operations and Homeland Security Investigations work throughout the Caribbean to combat the global cocaine trade. The "Caribbean Corridor" has become a gateway for criminal networks pushing cocaine to the U.S. and Europe. AMO and HSI agents seize millions in cocaine from smugglers and dismantle drug trafficking organizations operating in Puerto Rico and surrounding islands.
title: To Catch a Smuggler: Tropical Takedown

overview: Northwoods Survival follows a diverse group of young Canadians as they embark on a challenging four-season mission: to build a life in the vast and unforgiving Canadian wilderness. The series takes viewers on an adventure through some of the country's most remote and rugged landscapes as these aspiring homesteaders face the harsh realities of living off the land and strive to not just survive but to thrive in these wild places, they now call home.
title: Northwoods Survival

overview: Each year since 1992, players have annually honored the best Major League Baseball (MLB) talent, as the players themselves recognize their peers' most outstanding and inspiring performances. Each of the winners designates the charity of his choice to receive a grant from the Major League Baseball Players Trust, which has contributed more than $4 million to charities around the world as part of this award. The first year, Major Leaguers selected Dennis Eckersley and Barry Bonds as the AL & NL Outstanding Players, respectively. Today, the players annually honor the outstanding player, rookie, pitcher and comeback player in each league, while the Player of the Year and Man of the Year awards bestow top honors without regard to league. MLB Network has exclusively televised the MLB Players Choice Awards since 2011.
title: MLB Players Choice Awards

overview: Dating Horror Stories is a fresh digital sketch show from Comedy Central UK, blending humour with social commentary on modern dating. Fronted by rising comedic star Kyrah Gray, each episode revolves around the experiences of a single Black woman and the stereotypes and anxieties associated with dating in the 21st-century. Celebrity Cameos include Munya Chawawa, Kiell Smith-Bynoe and Ola Labib.
title: Dating Horror Stories

overview: In Zorro, a young Latinx woman discovers that her long-deceased father was the legendary hero Zorro. She takes on his masked persona to defend the desperate citizens of her Austin, Texas community from the wealthy forces seeking to exploit them.
title: Zorro

overview: As a result of an accident, forensic expert Vera Lisitsyna gains mental vision, which allows her to see lies. The new ability greatly helps in investigating complex crimes, but adds problems in her personal life and communication with colleagues.
title: Лиса

overview: David moves to Berlin to live with his girlfriend, but she dumps him immediately. Unwilling to give up on his hyper-romantic expectations about friendship, love and paying rent, he decides to stay. Things don't go as planned.
title: Beter wordt het niet

overview: A weekly interview made by Raf Reshef
title: Intimate

overview: A series of documentaries, each of which tells of a strange and mysterious chain of events. Unusual love stories and family secrets, strange dreams and minor events that change a person's life. Alexander Rapoport will give his commentary on the events and his personal vision of what is happening.
title: Новые мистические истории

overview: A portrait that shows the spectacular work of Thibaut Courtois to reach the decisive stretch of the season after the serious injury suffered just before the start of LaLiga. We will experience the uncertainty of undergoing surgery, the sacrifice he made to get back to his best, his day-to-day life with Mishel, his children and family, his intense schedule and other previously unknown facets.
title: Courtois, the Return of the Number 1

overview: City-bred graduate Siddarth reluctantly takes on the role of Panchayat secretary in the quirky village of Thalaivettiyaan Paalayam, where he faces a series of humorous challenges as he struggles to adapt to his new rural life and not-so-cool job.
title: Thalaivettiyaan Paalayam

overview: The Hockey Hall of Fame annually hosts a ceremony to induct that year's class of enshrinees including players, builders and referees/linesmen -- honoring their contributions to the game of hockey. The NHL Hall of Fame Induction Ceremony has aired annually on the NHL Network in the United States since 2011. Prior to 2011 one of the ESPN networks has aired the annual ceremony in the United States.
title: NHL Hall of Fame Induction Ceremony

overview: The continued (mis)adventures of teenage assassin duo Chisato Sugimoto and Mahiro Fukagawa.
title: Baby Assassins Everyday!

overview: Inspired by a true crime that gripped a whole nation for more than a decade. In the spring of 1999, the body of a 16-year-old girl was found on the outskirts of a small village in The Netherlands, next to an asylum seekers' center. ‘Een van ons' depicts how the long and frustrating search for the perpetrator confronted the inhabitants and asylum seekers of this little Dutch town with xenophobia, racism, and bizarre and persistent conspiracy theories, fueled by social media. The crime remained unsolved for more than 12 years, until an unprecedented use of a large-scale DNA investigation finally solved the case.
title: Een van ons

overview: Flávia Alessandra and Otaviano Costa welcome four couples who decide to test the limits of their relationships on a paradise island in Mexico. In separate Villas – each filled with seductive Singles – they will live the most electrifying experience of their lives. Will these relationships resist temptations?
title: Ilha da Tentação: Brasil

overview: A chance encounter collides the fates of Naman and Kavya on a flight propelling them on an unforeseen journey of love. But as time unfolds, will they surpass the turbulent complexities of their contrasting worlds and backgrounds to embrace the love that's in the air?
title: Ishq in the Air

overview: In the heart of the Nicobar Islands lies Moksha, a private island created by Dr. Viswak Sen as a reflection of his inner world. When a group of visitors arrive for a tour, they encounter a series of unexplained deaths and tragedies, leaving them wondering: is this a tour or a trap?
title: The Mystery of Moksha Island

overview: A cruel tyrant or a seer on the throne? I call the drama about the most mysterious Russian emperor Paul a tyrant and even a madman, but his character and history are much deeper than the mask that his descendants have unfairly given him. The alienation of his mother's murder, the rejection of the court and the endless attempts to analyze who and why his father really was, formed a deeply tragic personality. Having become emperor after many years of waiting, Paul sought to get rid of the permissiveness of the nobility and improve the lives of serfs and ordinary soldiers. How will he be able to realize his plans and retain power?
title: Павел. Первый и последний

overview: Twenty years since the first free elections and in the shadow of Nelson Mandela's death, Reggie Yates gets up close and personal with three very different communities in contemporary South Africa. By living amongst them for a week, what will he discover about the extremes of this misunderstood country in the 21st Century? Reggie Yates lives with three different communities within South Africa to try and understand why the country is so misunderstood.
title: Reggie Yates' Extreme South Africa

overview: The Ingebrigtsen brothers are back in a dramatic season. Without a coach, the brothers must support each other while their father Gjert is under investigation. Jakob is expecting a child and faces injury issues. Henrik juggle
title: Ingebrigtsen - Born to Run

overview: Timothy Love is a confirmed bachelor but when he meets Judy he is willing to give up his individualism for her - and her 3 children ... and dog.
title: Let There Be Love

overview: A British spy helps a Russian scientist to defect from the Soviet Union by taking a perilous journey through the Eastern Bloc.
title: The Contract

overview: Nuria García works in a factory owned by the Zepeda Group to support her sister and her son. She maintains a relationship with Braulio and feels that everything is fine in her life, but her world takes a sudden nosedive when her child is kidnapped. When Andrés tries to escape from his kidnappers, he suffers an accident that leaves him without memories and ends up in an orphanage. Amelia, Braulio's wife, adopts him and soon after faces a crossroads when she discovers that the child is not an orphan. Nuria never stops looking for her son and arrives in Mexico City, where she meets Santiago, the man who will help her find the answers she seeks while he himself seeks to vindicate his tarnished reputation. Together, they must overcome obstacles and find redemption in the face of adversity.
title: Vuelve a mí

overview: Rafael Méndez is a prolific seller of all kinds of household products. Alejandra Maldonado is the successful Commercial Manager of Ramenautos. She is a woman of aristocratic origin, while Méndez is of peasant origin. Méndez is in a relationship with Vicky Pardo, a sensual and jealous neighbor. Alejandra is about to marry Luciano Valenzuela, her prince charming. One fine day, fate crosses Alejandra with Méndez in a fatal accident and, from then on, their lives and those of the people close to them will never be the same again. Méndez will have to do everything possible to settle the debt with which he has left Alejandra after the accident and this closeness will lead them to fall in love despite the social differences. However, circumstances and their respective families and partners will do everything possible so that the love that has arisen between them cannot come true, making them enemies again, leaving Alejandra in poverty and Méndez in wealth.
title: Hasta que la plata nos separe

overview: Alejandra Maldonado and Rafael Méndez come from opposing worlds and star in an unconventional romance.
title: Hasta que la plata nos separe

overview: Missing, Presumed Dead is a true crime series that tells the stories of real-life disappearances and rediscoveries from the perspective of the missing people, their loved ones, and the investigators.
title: Missing, Presumed Dead

overview: Mobeen Azhar investigates how a protest outside an asylum seeker hotel in Merseyside in 2023 turned into a riot, uncovering a blueprint for a national wave of violence.
title: Small Town, Big Riot

overview: Russia is the largest country on earth and home to nearly 150 million people. Vladimir Putin is well into his third term as president and with the West imposing tough sanctions, relations are now the frostiest since the Cold War. Reggie Yates gets up close and personal with three very different communities in contemporary Russia, exploring what it's like for young people there, 24 years after the fall of the Soviet Union.
title: Reggie Yates' Extreme Russia

overview: From exceptional enclaves and secluded sanctuaries to awe-inspiring archipelagos and hidden havens, what is it like to live on one of the UK's 6000 teeny-tiny islands?
title: Our Tiny Islands

overview: Ning Jin Hai is an assassin from Bai Yu Jing - a place where homeless women gather and train to become female assassins. These assassins are then dispatched under the name of "Yin Niang."
title: The Assassin

overview: With exclusive access to unprecedent archeological discoveries, Field of Vampires travels throughout Eastern, Central and Western Europe and the US to understand how the myth of vampires began, unlock the secrets of the extraordinary ritual burials of those suspected of vampiric behaviour, and explore why some dead people were singled out as being vampires.
title: Field of Vampires

overview: Guo Cong, Chief of the Travel Inspection Division at Huayan Airport Customs in Binhai, leads officers Zhang Yu, Lü Xiaoyan, Yan Bowen, and others in holding the frontline of national security. Within the fifty-meter stretch of the customs clearance channel, they see through deception, intercept smugglers, and crack down on a series of complex cases—from illegal gene sample trafficking and drug-concealed carpets to the smuggling of precious artworks, HPV vaccines, luxury watches, antiques, and psychotropic drugs. Through relentless efforts, they overcome daunting challenges, uncover the masterminds behind the smuggling rings, and safeguard the nation's interests. These young customs officers, in this process, gain invaluable experience and forge unbreakable bonds in the line of duty.
title: Gimlet Eyes

overview: The story follows the Shen family, who accidentally arrive in Yong'an City and encounter Lin Yan, a royal official. This chance meeting leads them on an extraordinary journey filled with culinary delights, local traditions, and an unconventional love story. But what twists and turns await them in this remarkable adventure?
title: Yummy Yummy Yummy

overview: Mingzhu, whose family life was happy and love sweet, had just registered her marriage and discovered she was pregnant, when her husband Jianqi tragically died while performing a heroic act. Amidst the swirling opinions of others, Mingzhu made her own firm decision to keep the child, only to be confronted by the arrival of her long-lost biological parents. Through the bittersweet reconnection with her family, she gradually overcame her grief. But when her father-in-law unexpectedly passed away, it revealed that her in-laws' family was deeply in debt. Stepping up with courage, Mingzhu sorted out the debts, took over the business, and united her family like never before, rebuilding their lives with renewed vigor.
title: Those Days

overview: Pedro returns to Colombia to rebuild his relationship with his son, but it won't be an easy task.
title: Pedro El Escamoso: Más Escamoso que Nunca

overview: Tommy Gavin is a lifesaver. Whether he is pulling survivors from fiery high-rise infernos or the twisted steel of a subway collision, Gavin takes great pride in leading the heroic but often overwhelmed firefighters of New York City's Truck Company 62. Gavin is also a man drifting between sorrow and anger over a recent separation from his wife and three kids, and recurring memories of comrades and other New-Yorkers who fell victim to the tragedy of 9/11.
title: Rescue Me

overview: Strippers is a documentary series that takes a look at strip clubs which have doubled over the last 10 years with more and more young British women are turning to lap dancing to try and make a living.
title: Strippers

overview: The Fishbowl is a procedural about a brilliant medical examiner overseeing a private room at the Manhattan morgue that investigates New York City's weirdest deaths.
title: The Fishbowl

overview: A liberal-minded chief deputy district attorney in the Los Angeles D.A.'s office finds her professional world profoundly shifted when a conservative district attorney becomes her new boss.
title: For the People

overview: Active and purposeful Lida is studying for a master's degree and works in a Fashion house in St. Petersburg. Her parents own a small weaving factory, and Lida is obsessed with taking the family business to a new level. For the sake of an internship abroad, she is ready to fulfill the condition of the host party in a few days — to be married. With the help of a friend, she quickly finds a man who agrees to arrange a fictitious marriage. Suddenly, Lida's father goes to the hospital with a heart attack, she has to cancel her internship and head the factory. On a business trip, she meets Igor. A stormy romance breaks out between them, which is quickly followed by a marriage proposal. Now Lida urgently needs to find her fictitious husband and get a divorce. But he went on a geological expedition. Lida goes in search of him…
title: Фиктивный брак

overview: The year is 1968. Crimea. The corpse of a twenty-year-old Muscovite woman who fell off the rocks was found by the sea. The deceased girl came with her friends to relax "savages" on the coast. The investigation will have to find out if it was an accident or if it was all the fault of a difficult relationship within the company.
title: Падающая звезда

overview: A mix of Brazilian popular music plus interviews with the most prominent artists in the Brazilian scene.
title: Esquenta!

overview: Alf Butler is a greengrocer and after buying a hairdressing salon he employs a professional manager to run it - but she runs it rather too well.
title: No Appointment Necessary

overview: Roger's acrimonious divorce is not helped when his new lover marries an all-in wrestler.
title: Roger Doesn't Live Here Anymore

overview: Having indulged his wife's interest in Parliament for many years, Henry Prendergast has to take her more seriously now she's an MP.
title: My Honourable Mrs

overview: Secret Sex Lives is a reality show exploring secretive sex lives.
title: Secret Sex Lives

overview: A travelling cook turns a run down transport cafe into a fashionable restaurant.
title: As Good Cooks Go

overview: John Hughes joined MI5 during the war on terror and was at the forefront of averting the biggest terrorist plots on UK soil. Now in his mid 40s and married with two children he's struggling to adapt to the new MI5, where threats to national security have changed and he's forced to adapt to the values of a progressive work environment.
title: Betrayal

overview: An alleged UFO landing in Truskasy, Warmia, spurs a group's quest of self-discovery and inquiry into the origins of the extraterrestrial.
title: Projekt UFO

overview: The SkyShowtime Original A Recipe for Murder is a compelling documentary series that chronicles the violent death of Colombian surgeon Edwin Arrieta on a tranquil Thai island, at the hands of Daniel Sancho, a 29-year-old aspiring chef known for his YouTube videos. Sancho, the son of one of Spain's most well-known actors, Rodolfo Sancho, was tried and convicted to life imprisonment in a Thai court earlier this summer. In spite of the trial being covered extensively by the world's media, mysteries remain about the nature of the relationship between Arrieta and Sancho. The five-part series explores the truth behind not only their relationship but also the double life led by each man. While examining a toxic relationship, the shocking discovery of a dismembered body, and the investigation that followed, renowned documentary filmmaker Jose Gomez shines a light on the role of the Thai legal system, the media, and even the audience itself.
title: A Recipe for Murder

overview: Action-adventure series based on the novel by Edgar Wallace about four international characters who team up to fight injustice.
title: The Four Just Men

overview: Variations on a theme in the form of poetry, comedy sketches, songs and discussion.
title: But Seriously, It's Sheila Hancock

overview: We get close to the downtown police patrol in their daily work to create safety and security on the streets of Copenhagen.
title: Gadebetjentene

overview: Starting on the day a long, dormant feud between two local families is brutally reignited, this continuing drama is based around a busy Dublin Garda station. On one side, the Hennessys, a local dynasty, whose name is above half the businesses in town. On the other side, the Kielys, who have turned petty crime into a cottage industry. Charting the life and dramas of a community about to be enveloped by a feud, through the eyes of those who police it, each episode will be a mix of 'crime of the week' stories and on-going serial arcs, following principle characters in both their professional and personal lives. A powerful and moving drama, Red Rock is a contemporary western, set in the shadow of Ireland's 'gold rush'.
title: Red Rock

overview: The team at Irv's Resto Shop in Barrow-in-Furness, Cumbria, are world renowned for their work rescuing classic cars that appear to be beyond repair. Big character, Paul "Irv" Irving, and his three sons love taking on the most ambitious, challenging jobs. Their crew of welders, fabricators, blasters, painters and mechanics have the knowledge, skills and the passion to bring vehicles not just back from the brink, but onto the concourse. These classic car kings are restoration royalty.
title: Classic Car Kings

overview: Football Fantastics is packed with big personalities, toe-tapping songs, laugh-out-loud moments, and plenty of heart. Whether you're mad about football or just love a great story, this is a series that scores every time.
title: Football Fantastics

overview: Go Get Arty is here! Hang out with the super creative family, the Kwapongs, and their hilarious sidekick, Bristles the talking paintbrush.
title: Go Get Arty

overview: Michelle McManus serves up big-name interviews, features and the latest in entertainment and culture news from across Scotland.
title: The Entertainment Mix

overview: Ria has never had the time or opportunity to think about what she might actually want from the world. So, when she starts cleaning for Fran, she's intoxicated by this confident and self-assured woman who encourages her to take control of her life and, when Ria flourishes, an intense friendship is forged. However, when Fran's advice leads to a shocking event, the lives of these two very different women become intertwined by shared secrets and dangerous plots. What follows is a compelling and manipulative game of cat-and-mouse. But just who is playing who?
title: The Guest

overview: Coverage of horse racing.
title: Rasaí Lios Tuathail

overview: An Apache Indian becomes a Deputy U.S. Marshal.
title: Law of the Plainsman

overview: Making News is a British television drama set in the world of journalism.
title: Making News

overview: Married at First Sight is a ground-breaking series which asks if science can help us fall in love. Chosen from an initial pool of over 1500 applicants, individuals seeking long-term love are carefully assessed by a panel of experts in the fields of psychology, social and evolutionary anthropology, and theology. Once matched, three highly compatible couples prepare to enter into a legally-binding marriage with a complete stranger - meeting for the very first time at their own wedding where they'll declare 'I do'. But what makes the perfect match? And will everyone make it down the aisle?
title: Married at First Sight UK

overview: Hosted by cook, author, columnist, radio presenter and News Breakfast foodie, Alice Zaslavsky, A Bite To Eat with Alice will focus on recipes that are simple and fresh, built around accessible and affordable ingredients that can be prepared at home to inspire Australian audiences to feel more confident in the kitchen. Alice will kickstart each episode with a recipe inspired by her special guest. Then her guest arrives, bringing in one of their favourite ingredients for Alice to turn into something delicious, showing those at home how easy it is to get dinner on the table with ingredients on hand. Finally, Alice faces a challenge to change the guest's mind about an ingredient they don't enjoy or are unsure how to cook, or to help them with a food-related issue.
title: A Bite to Eat with Alice

overview: Dáithí Ó Sé hosts his weekly chat show 'Seal le Dáithí' on TG4. Each week Dáithí will chat one-to-one with a different guest where they will share their life story and experiences.
title: Seal le Dáithí

overview: Xiaoxiao, a soul harried by marriage pressures, unexpectedly traverses time and ends up in the body of an ancient man, embarking on a joyous journey where she cohabits a body with Chu Xiaoran, an ancient bathhouse attendant. Armed with a magical pouch that produces any modern item at will, Xiaoxiao helps Chu Xiaoran win over the aloof princess. Meanwhile, she takes advantage of inhabiting Chu Xiaoran's body to flirt outrageously with the handsome and attractive men of the era.
title: The Girl Inside Me

overview: It's on again! The Koori Knockout draw is back! Catch All the Key match ups from the biggest weekend the Indigenous Calendar. LIVE Bathurst on Wiradjuri Country.
title: Koori Knockout Live
